Automatic lock

Locks when the screen turns off or the application goes into the background, including picture-in-picture. Background playback stops. App screenshots and recents previews are protected while the lock is enabled.
What the additional PIN deletes

Entering this PIN deletes local history and searches, open pages, my posts and reply history, bookmarks, custom boards and communities, drafts and queued messages, temporary attachments, caches and translations, video position, forum login data, cookies, saved names and email, deletion passwords, proxy addresses and credentials, and internal diagnostic logs. Background reply tracking is disabled. Appearance, PINs, biometrics, installed extensions and language models remain. Downloaded files and exported backups remain UNLESS folder cleanup was separately enabled. Forum posts and copies outside that folder are not deleted. The main PIN cannot restore deleted data. Folder permissions and folder cleanup approval are reset afterward.
I understand, continue

Cleanup could not finish. Data remains locked. Close and reopen Slooop to retry.
Protection limits

This is an application lock, not encryption of existing data or protection against a compromised device. Cleanup does not guarantee forensic erasure and cannot delete copies outside its approved scope. There is no forgotten-PIN recovery; clearing app data loses the local profile. Test the additional PIN only on disposable data.
